_comment: Brand names. 'aliases': [regex, canonical] (first match wins, case-insensitive, whole string) -- what manufacturers call themselves in UPnP/Home Assistant/OUI records ('Samsung Electronics Co.,Ltd', 'Яндекс', 'TUYA INC.') -> one brand. 'not_brands': strings that show up in manufacturer fields but are software or integration authors, never a brand. 'module_makers': chip/Wi-Fi module vendors: their OUI is inside other brands' products, so an OUI alone never makes them the device's brand.
aliases: sony( corporation| group| interactive.*| home ent.*| visual.*)?
